response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avgs AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, cnt AS count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM avgs WHERE avg_share IS NOT NULL AND share > avg_share
